roadmap.title: Learn the basics and early progression
roadmap.description: Play your first trials, grow characters in the Bloodweb and make early Prestige steps.

roadmap.title: Survivor skills
roadmap.description: Repair generators, heal, unhook, escape and survive chases as a Survivor.

roadmap.title: Killer skills
roadmap.description: Hook, sacrifice, hit and down Survivors using general Killer skills.

roadmap.title: Map and event challenges
roadmap.description: Complete achievements tied to a specific map, Hidden objectives and special modes.

roadmap.title: Character-specific powers
roadmap.description: Use a single Killer's power or a single Survivor's perk effects to unlock their achievement.

roadmap.title: Adept mastery
roadmap.description: Escape or win with one character using only that character's three unique perks.

roadmap.title: Long-term totals
roadmap.description: Reach large cumulative totals such as many sacrifices, Prestige levels and Bloodweb depth.

achievements.description: In a public match, get 4 sacrifices in a single match.
achievements.summary: Have the Entity claim every one of the four Survivors during one trial.

steps.text: Hook every Survivor until the Entity sacrifices all four before the trial ends.

achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice a total of 100 survivors.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice a total of 100 Survivors to the Entity as the Killer in public matches.

steps.text: Hook Survivors until the Entity claims them, until you have sacrificed 100 Survivors across public matches.

achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice a total of 1000 survivors.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice a total of 1,000 Survivors to the Entity as the Killer in public matches.

steps.text: Hook Survivors until the Entity claims them, until you have sacrificed 1,000 Survivors across public matches.

achievements.description: Kill your first Survivor by your own hands.
achievements.summary: As a Killer, kill a Survivor directly with your own action instead of by hook sacrifice.

guide.context: A hook sacrifice and bleeding a Survivor out do not count as direct kills.

steps.text: Bring a Memento Mori offering and use it to kill a Survivor.

achievements.description: Kill all four Survivors by your own hands in a single Trial.
achievements.summary: As a Killer, kill all four Survivors directly with your own action in a single trial, not by hook sacrifice.

guide.context: A hook sacrifice and bleeding a Survivor out do not count as direct kills.

steps.text: Bring a Memento Mori offering and use it to kill a Survivor.
Keep hooking the other Survivors and kill each one directly too, until all four are dead.

achievements.description: Kill Survivors by your own hands a total of 25 times.
achievements.summary: As a Killer, kill Survivors directly with your own action 25 times in total, not by hook sacrifice.

guide.context: Progress is not shown in game. A hook sacrifice and bleeding a Survivor out do not count as direct kills.

steps.text: Bring Memento Mori offerings to trials and use them to kill Survivors until you reach 25 direct kills.

achievements.description: In public matches, with the Trapper, pick up a total of 100 survivors caught in your Bear Traps.
achievements.summary: As The Trapper, pick up 100 Survivors who are still stuck in a Bear Trap.

steps.text: Play The Trapper and walk up to a Survivor who is struggling in a Bear Trap, then pick that Survivor up; do this 100 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, with the Wraith, Surprise & hit a total of 100 survivors.
achievements.summary: As The Wraith, land Surprise Attacks a total of 100 times.

steps.text: Play The Wraith, uncloak, and hit Survivors with the first attack after uncloaking.

achievements.description: In public matches, with the Hillbilly, chainsaw a total of 100 survivors.
achievements.summary: As The Hillbilly, land 100 hits on Survivors using the Chainsaw Sprint.

steps.text: Play as The Hillbilly and hit Survivors with Chainsaw Sprint until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: In a public match, successfully escape the hook and escape.
achievements.summary: Get off a Hook by yourself and then leave the trial by an Exit Gate.

guide.context: The Hatch does not count. Being the last Survivor on a Hook ends in a sacrifice before you can free yourself.

steps.text: Safely unhook a teammate with Deliverance equipped, then get hooked and free yourself with it. Leave the trial through an Exit Gate.

achievements.description: In public matches, escape the match alive for a total of 100 times.
achievements.summary: Escape from 100 Trials in public matches.

steps.text: Escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch in public matches until you have 100 escapes.

achievements.description: Escape a trial while in the Dying State.
achievements.summary: Escape a trial through an Exit Gate or the Hatch while in the Dying State.

steps.text: Get downed, then crawl out through an open Exit Gate or into the Hatch before the trial ends.

achievements.description: Escape a trial through the Hatch.
achievements.summary: Escape a trial through the Hatch.

steps.text: Stay alive until you are the last Survivor left, then jump into the open Hatch.
steps.note: The Hatch appears and opens by itself once only one Survivor is alive.

achievements.description: Escape a trial through the Hatch after opening it with a Key.
achievements.summary: Use a Key to open the Hatch, then escape the trial through it.

guide.context: The Killer has to close the Hatch before a Key can open it.

steps.text: Bring a Key that has Charges left into the trial.
Stay alive until you are the last Survivor left, and wait until the Killer has closed the Hatch.
Open the Hatch with the Key and escape through it.

achievements.description: In public matches, save a total of 50 survivors from death.
achievements.summary: Perform 50 safe unhooks on teammates.

steps.text: Safely unhook teammates until you have done it 50 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, rescue someone after at least one gate has opened.
achievements.summary: In a public match, take another Survivor off a Hook once the Exit Gates are powered.

steps.text: Finish all Generators, then unhook a Survivor from a Hook before leaving.

achievements.description: In public matches, heal others for a total of 100 health states.
achievements.summary: Across public matches, restore 100 Health States on other Survivors.

steps.text: Heal injured Survivors in public matches until you have healed 100 Health States in total.

achievements.description: In public matches, repair generators for a total of 100 full repairs.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 Generator repairs.

steps.text: Finish repairing Generators until you have completed 100 in total.

achievements.description: In public matches, get a total of 500 successful Skill-Checks.
achievements.summary: Succeed at 500 Skill Checks in public matches.

steps.text: Repair Generators and heal in public matches, passing Skill Checks until you reach 500 successes.

achievements.description: In a public match, as a survivor, complete with at least 5000 blood points in each score category.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor in a public match, end the Trial with 5,000 or more Bloodpoints in every one of the four Scoring Categories.

steps.text: Score 5,000 or more in every category during one Trial, then finish the match.

achievements.description: In a public match, as a killer, complete with at least 5000 blood points in each score category.
achievements.summary: Play a Killer match and end it with 5,000 or more Bloodpoints earned in every one of the four Scoring Categories.

steps.text: Reach 5,000 Bloodpoints separately in Brutality, Deviousness, Hunter and Sacrifice, the four Killer Scoring Categories, before the match ends.

achievements.description: In a public match, get more than 8K blood points in one scoring category.
achievements.summary: In a public match, reach the 10,000 Bloodpoint maximum in any one of the four Scoring Categories.

steps.text: Keep scoring in one category until it reaches the 10,000 Bloodpoint cap.

achievements.description: Raise a character level to 10.
achievements.summary: Bring any Character's Bloodweb up to Level 10.

steps.text: Spend Bloodpoints in one Character's Bloodweb until it reaches Level 10.

achievements.description: Raise a character level to 25.
achievements.summary: Bring any Character's Bloodweb up to Level 25.

steps.text: Spend Bloodpoints in one Character's Bloodweb until it reaches Level 25.

achievements.description: Accumulate a total of 1 million blood points. (blood points can be spent before reaching the total)
achievements.summary: Earn 1,000,000 Bloodpoints in total.

guide.context: Spending Bloodpoints does not lower the total.

steps.text: Earn Bloodpoints by playing matches until your total reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Silver I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Silver I Grade as a Survivor.

steps.text: Play Survivor trials and rank up until you reach Silver I.

achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Gold I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Gold I Grade as a Survivor.

steps.text: Play Survivor matches and score well until your Survivor Grade reaches Gold I.

achievements.description: Reach survivor online grade Iridescent I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Iridescent I Grade as a Survivor.

steps.text: Keep playing Survivor trials and ranking up until you reach Iridescent I.

achievements.description: Raise your grade for the first time.
achievements.summary: Move up one Grade for the first time, playing as either Killer or Survivor.

steps.text: Play a match and score enough to move up from Ash IV.

achievements.description: Reach killer online grade Silver I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Grade Silver I as a Killer.

steps.text: Play Killer matches until your Killer Grade reaches Silver I.

achievements.description: Reach killer online grade Gold I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Grade Gold I as a Killer.

steps.text: Play Killer matches until your Killer Grade reaches Gold I.

achievements.description: Reach Killer Iridescent I.
achievements.summary: Reach the Grade Iridescent I as a Killer.

steps.text: Play Killer matches until your Killer Grade reaches Iridescent I.

achievements.description: In a public match, burn a Visceral offering.
achievements.summary: Burn a Visceral Offering before a Trial in a public match.

steps.text: Select a Visceral Offering before the match starts and burn it.

achievements.description: Start a public match with a full survivor loadout.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, start a trial with every Load-Out slot filled.

steps.text: Fill every Load-Out slot, with an offering and an Item that has two add-ons, then enter a trial.

achievements.description: Start a public match with a full killer loadout.
achievements.summary: Start a public match as the Killer with every Load-Out slot filled.

steps.text: Fill every slot of your Killer Load-Out before the match, then start a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, as a survivor, use a visceral item or add-on without using a protective ward.
achievements.summary: Escape as a Survivor holding an Ultra Rare Item, or holding your own brought Item that has an Ultra Rare Add-on, with no White Ward protecting it.

steps.text: Bring an Ultra Rare Item or an Ultra Rare Add-on, do not burn a White Ward for it, and escape.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape while bringing a new item to the campfire.
achievements.summary: Escape from a public match while carrying a new Item from the match back to The Campfire.

steps.text: Pick up an Item from a Chest or from another Survivor and escape with it.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with an item that another player brought into the match.
achievements.summary: Escape from a public match while carrying an Item that another Survivor brought into that match.

steps.text: Take an Item that belonged to another Survivor and escape with it.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Jake using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Jake Park while having only Jake Park's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Jake Park, equip only these three: Iron Will; Calm Spirit; Saboteur. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Dwight using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Dwight Fairfield while having only Dwight Fairfield's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Dwight Fairfield, equip only these three: Bond; Prove Thyself; Leader. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Claudette using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Claudette Morel while having only Claudette Morel's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Claudette Morel, equip only these three: Empathy; Botany Knowledge; Self-Care. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Meg using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Meg Thomas while having only Meg Thomas's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Meg Thomas, equip only these three: Quick & Quiet; Sprint Burst; Adrenaline. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Trapper using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Trapper in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Trapper's three unique perks as your only perks: Agitation, Brutal Strength, and Unnerving Presence.
Play a public match as The Trapper and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Wraith using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Wraith in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Wraith's three unique perks as your only perks: Shadowborn, Bloodhound, and Predator.
Play a public match as The Wraith and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Hillbilly using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Hillbilly in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Hillbilly's three unique perks as your only perks: Tinkerer, Lightborn, and Enduring.
Play a public match as The Hillbilly and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: Boost any perk to level 3.
achievements.summary: Upgrade any Perk to Tier III through the Bloodweb.

steps.text: Buy upgrades of the same Perk in the Bloodweb until it reaches Tier III.

achievements.description: Reach prestige Level I with any character.
achievements.summary: Prestige any Character to Prestige 1.

steps.text: Raise one Character's Bloodweb to Level 50 and Prestige them.

achievements.description: Reach prestige Level II with any character.
achievements.summary: Prestige any Character to Prestige 2.

steps.text: Raise a Prestige 1 Character's Bloodweb to Level 50 and Prestige them again.

achievements.description: Reach prestige Level III with any character.
achievements.summary: Prestige any Character to Prestige 3.

steps.text: Raise a Prestige 2 Character's Bloodweb to Level 50 and Prestige them again.

achievements.description: Reach prestige Level III-50 with any character.
achievements.summary: Take the Bloodweb of a Prestige 3 Character up to Level 50.

steps.text: Raise a Prestige 3 Character's Bloodweb to Level 50.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape the Disturbed Ward without losing a single drop of blood.
achievements.summary: Escape from Disturbed Ward without a single injury.

guide.context: Any injury ends the attempt for that match.

steps.text: On Disturbed Ward, avoid every hit from the Killer and escape the trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator on the second floor of the Disturbed Ward and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Shock Therapy Centre, Second Floor within Disturbed Ward, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Disturbed Ward}.
Repair the Generator located in the Shock Therapy Centre, Second Floor until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Nea using only her 3 unique perks
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Nea Karlsson while having only Nea Karlsson's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Nea Karlsson, equip only these three: Balanced Landing; Urban Evasion; Streetwise. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, with the Nurse, blink and successfully land an attack a total of 500 times.
achievements.summary: As The Nurse, successfully land Blink Attacks a total of 500 times.

steps.text: Play The Nurse and land attacks at the end of a Blink.

achievements.description: In a public match, chain 3 or more blinks and land on a survivor, grabbing him successfully.
achievements.summary: As The Nurse with the Torn Bookmark Add-on equipped, chain 3 Blinks to grab a Survivor who is interacting with a Prop and interrupt them.

guide.context: The three Blinks must be chained so that the last one ends on the Survivor.

steps.text: Equip the Torn Bookmark Add-on on The Nurse before the match.
Find a Survivor interacting with a Prop, then chain 3 Blinks and grab them to interrupt the action.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with the Nurse using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Nurse in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Nurse's three unique perks as your only perks: A Nurse's Calling, Thanatophobia, and Stridor.
Play a public match as The Nurse and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match as a Killer, have all four Survivors injured at the same time.
achievements.summary: Make every one of the four Survivors injured simultaneously.

steps.text: Injure Survivors without downing them until all four are injured at once.

achievements.description: In a public match, use a key to open a chest.
achievements.summary: Open a Chest with a Key.

steps.text: Bring a Key into a trial and use it on a Chest.

achievements.description: In public matches, hook the Obsession 300 times.
achievements.summary: Put the Obsession on a hook 300 times in public matches.

steps.text: Hook the Survivor who is the Obsession; do this 300 times.

achievements.description: As a Killer, finish a public match with at least one Hex totem standing.
achievements.summary: Finish a match with at least one Hex Totem still standing.

steps.text: Equip a Hex Perk. At the start of the match it turns one Totem into a Hex Totem, so keep that Hex Totem uncleansed until the match ends.

achievements.description: In a single public match, repair generators for at least 300 seconds.
achievements.summary: Spend at least 300 seconds repairing Generators within one public match.

steps.text: Collect 300 seconds of Generator repair time in one public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, as the killer's obsession, escape as the last survivor without getting hit.
achievements.summary: While you are the Obsession, be the final Survivor out through an Exit Gate without losing any blood.

steps.text: Be the Obsession, stay unhurt for the whole trial, and be the last Survivor through an Exit Gate.

achievements.description: In public matches, with The Hag, cause survivors to trigger her Phantasm traps 300 times.
achievements.summary: As The Hag, get Survivors to set off your Phantasm Traps 300 times.

steps.text: Play as The Hag, set Phantasm Traps along Survivors' paths, and keep going until 300 triggers.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Hag using only her 3 unique perks
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Hag in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Hag's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Devour Hope, Hex: Ruin, and Hex: The Third Seal.
Play a public match as The Hag and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, activate the Foghorn by repairing the generator in the Steamboat and escape.
achievements.summary: In a public match as a Survivor, repair the Generator inside the Steamboat on The Pale Rose and escape the trial.

steps.text: Load into The Pale Rose and finish the Generator inside the Steamboat.
Survive and escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch.

achievements.description: In public matches, cleanse 100 Hex totems.
achievements.summary: Cleanse 100 Hex totems.

steps.text: Cleanse every Hex totem you find until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Ace using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Ace Visconti while having only Ace Visconti's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Ace Visconti, equip only these three: Open-Handed; Up the Ante; Ace in the Hole. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a public match, teleport to your Phantasm traps and hit all 4 individual survivors at least once.
achievements.summary: While you play The Hag in one match, land a hit on each of the four Survivors right after teleporting to a Phantasm Trap.

guide.context: Each Survivor must be hit after a teleport; hits that are not preceded by a teleport do not count.

steps.text: Play The Hag and set Phantasm Traps, then teleport to a Phantasm Trap and hit a Survivor.
Repeat until each of the four Survivors has been hit after one of your teleports, all in the same match.

achievements.description: Protect a recently unhooked Survivor by taking a hit near them 250 times.
achievements.summary: Take 250 Protection Hits within 10 metres of a Hook.

steps.text: Take the Killer's hit for a Survivor you just unhooked while within 10 metres of the Hook. Do this 250 times.

achievements.description: As the last person still alive, activate the last generator and escape through the exit gate.
achievements.summary: As the Last Survivor Standing, repair any remaining Generators and escape through an Exit Gate.

guide.context: The Hatch does not count, and the Generator must be completed after your last teammate has died.

steps.text: After every teammate is dead, finish repairing the last Generators and leave through an Exit Gate.

achievements.description: Escape with Bill using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial as Bill Overbeck while having only Bill Overbeck's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Bill Overbeck, equip only these three: Left Behind; Borrowed Time; Unbreakable. Then escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In public matches, repair a Generator in the Damage state , 50 Times. One time per generator.
achievements.summary: Complete repairs on 50 separate Generators that the Killer had already damaged.

steps.text: Repair Generators the Killer has damaged until 50 different ones have been repaired.

achievements.description: In public matches, jump over a pallet or through a window during a chase, 200 times.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, vault Pallets or Windows while being chased by the Killer a total of 200 times.

steps.text: Vault Pallets or Windows while the Killer chases you until the total reaches 200.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Min using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Feng Min while having only Feng Min's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Feng Min, equip only these three: Technician; Lithe; Alert. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, hit survivors 500 times with The Doctor's Shock Therapy attack.
achievements.summary: Land 500 Shock Therapy attacks on Survivors while you play The Doctor.

steps.text: Play The Doctor and hit Survivors with Shock Therapy.

achievements.description: In a public match, bring the 4 survivors to insanity Tier 3 at least once in the same match.
achievements.summary: While you play The Doctor, bring every one of the four Survivors to Madness Tier III within one match.

steps.text: Play The Doctor and use Shock Therapy until all four Survivors reach Madness Tier III in the same match.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Doctor using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Doctor in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Doctor's three unique perks as your only perks: Overcharge, Monitor & Abuse, and Overwhelming Presence.
Play a public match as The Doctor and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Mother's Dwelling and live to tell the story.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Cottage within Mother's Dwelling, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Mother's Dwelling}.
Repair the Generator located in the Cottage until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, spend most of the trial injured (more than 50%) and live to tell the story.
achievements.summary: Escape from a public match after spending more than 50 percent of it injured.

steps.text: Stay injured for most of the Trial, then escape.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with David using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as David King while having only David King's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as David King, equip only these three: We're Gonna Live Forever; Dead Hard; No Mither. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, throw 1000 Hatchets.
achievements.summary: As The Huntress, throw Hunting Hatchets a total of 1,000 times.

steps.text: Play The Huntress and throw Hatchets, hit or miss.

achievements.description: In public matches, down survivors 20 times with The Huntress' Hatchets further than 24 meters.
achievements.summary: Down 20 Survivors with Hunting Hatchets thrown from 24 metres or farther while you play The Huntress.

steps.text: Play The Huntress and down Survivors with Hunting Hatchets thrown from at least 24 metres away.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Huntress using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Huntress in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Huntress's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Huntress Lullaby, Territorial Imperative, and Beast of Prey.
Play a public match as The Huntress and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, with The Cannibal, successfully chainsaw a total of 100 times.
achievements.summary: As The Cannibal, strike Survivors 100 times with the chainsaw during a Chainsaw Sweep.

steps.text: Play The Cannibal and hit Survivors with the chainsaw during a Chainsaw Sweep; do this 100 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, hook 25 Survivors in the Basement. Once per Survivor per match.
achievements.summary: Put Survivors onto Hooks that are in the Basement, 25 times overall.

guide.context: Each Survivor can add only one hook to the total per match.

steps.text: Hook Survivors on the Basement Hook until the total reaches 25.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Cannibal using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Cannibal in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Cannibal's three unique perks as your only perks: Franklin's Demise, Barbecue & Chilli, and Knock Out.
Play a public match as The Cannibal and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, unlock 100 chests.
achievements.summary: Unlock 100 Chests in public matches.

steps.text: Find and unlock Chests in public matches until you have unlocked 100 in total.
steps.note: Plunderer's Instinct shows Chest locations, and a Key opens Chests faster.

achievements.description: In public matches, open the exit gate 35 times as a Survivor.
achievements.summary: Open Exit Gates 25 times.

steps.text: Open Exit Gates until you have opened 25 in total.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Quentin using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Quentin Smith while having only Quentin Smith's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Quentin Smith, equip only these three: Wake Up!; Pharmacy; Vigil. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, pull 200 Survivors into the Dream World.
achievements.summary: As The Nightmare, drag Survivors into the Dream World 200 times.

steps.text: Play The Nightmare and drag Survivors into the Dream World; do this 200 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, Sacrifice the Obsession 30 times.
achievements.summary: Offer the Obsession to the Entity 30 times.

steps.text: Sacrifice the Survivor marked as the Obsession.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Nightmare using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Nightmare in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Nightmare's three unique perks as your only perks: Blood Warden, Remember Me, and Fire Up.
Play a public match as The Nightmare and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, have at least 3 survivors hooked in the basement at the same time.
achievements.summary: Have 3 Survivors hooked on Basement hooks at the same time in one match.

steps.text: Carry downed Survivors to the Basement and hang 3 of them on Basement hooks before any of them is unhooked.

achievements.description: In a public match, take the item from the chest in the basement in at least 30 different trials.
achievements.summary: Unlock the Chest inside the Basement and take its Item in 30 separate public matches.

steps.text: Find the Chest inside the Basement, unlock it and take its Item. Do this in 30 separate public matches.

achievements.description: Open at least 100 mystery boxes on the bloodweb (available during select special events).
achievements.summary: Purchase 100 Mystery Boxes in the Bloodweb.

guide.context: They are available only in Winter, Halloween, Summer and Anniversary Event series.

steps.text: During an event, buy Mystery Boxes in the Bloodweb until you have bought 100.

achievements.description: In public matches, get downed only once and escape the match alive, 25 times.
achievements.summary: Escape from 25 Trials in public matches after entering the Dying State no more than once in each.

steps.text: Escape a public match after being downed at most once. Do this 25 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in The Game's Bathroom and live to tell the story.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Bathroom within The Game, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{The Game}.
Repair the Generator located in the Bathroom until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Detective Tapp using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as David Tapp while having only David Tapp's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as David Tapp, equip only these three: Tenacity; Detective's Hunch; Stake Out. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.displayName: I Want to Play a Game
achievements.description: In public matches, with The Pig, put 125 Reverse Bear Traps on Survivors.
achievements.summary: Fit 125 Reverse Bear Traps onto downed Survivors while you play The Pig.

steps.text: Play The Pig and put a Reverse Bear Trap on each Survivor you down.

achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice or kill 30 Survivors after the last Generator has been activated.
achievements.summary: Kill or sacrifice Survivors a total of 30 times after the last Generator has been completed.

steps.text: Once the last Generator is completed, kill or sacrifice Survivors until you reach 30 in total across matches.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Pig using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Pig in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Pig's three unique perks as your only perks: Make Your Choice, Surveillance, and Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick.
Play a public match as The Pig and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the chapel and live to tell the tale.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Chapel within Father Campbell's Chapel, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Father Campbell's Chapel}.
Repair the Generator located in the Chapel until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In public matches, cause the killer to miss an attack before taking a vault, 50 times.
achievements.summary: Make the Killer miss a Basic Attack right before you vault, 50 times in public matches.

steps.text: In a Chase, make the Killer swing and miss, then vault. Do this 50 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Kate, using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Kate Denson while having only Kate Denson's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Kate Denson, equip only these three: Dance With Me; Windows of Opportunity; Boil Over. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, damage a generator while at least 1 Survivor is Hooked, 100 times.
achievements.summary: Hit Generators with damage 100 times at moments when a Survivor is on a hook.

steps.text: Damage a Generator while at least one Survivor is hanging on a hook.

achievements.description: In public matches, down 100 Survivors while they are intoxicated by The Afterpiece Tonic.
achievements.summary: Put 100 intoxicated Survivors into the dying state while you play The Clown.

steps.text: Play The Clown, throw Afterpiece Tonic at Survivors, then down them while intoxicated.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Clown, using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Clown in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Clown's three unique perks as your only perks: Pop Goes the Weasel, Coulrophobia, and Bamboozle.
Play a public match as The Clown and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Family Residence and live to tell the tale.
achievements.summary: In a public match as a Survivor, repair the Generator inside the Family Residence and escape the trial.

guide.context: The Family Residence is on the Yamaoka Estate.

steps.text: Load into the Family Residence and finish the Generator inside the residence.
Survive and escape through an Exit Gate or the Hatch.

achievements.description: In public matches, unhook yourself 50 times.
achievements.summary: Unhook yourself 50 times in public matches.

steps.text: Free yourself from a Hook in public matches until you have done it 50 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Adam using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Adam Francis while having only Adam Francis's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Adam Francis, equip only these three: Diversion; Deliverance; Autodidact. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, during a chase, damage a Survivor who drops a Pallet within a chase, 100 times.
achievements.summary: Strike a Survivor 100 times after they dropped a Pallet in the Chase you are in.

steps.text: After a Survivor drops a Pallet during a Chase, hit that Survivor in the same Chase.

achievements.description: In public matches, with The Spirit, use Yamaoka's Haunting to down 30 Survivors.
achievements.summary: As The Spirit, down 30 Survivors soon after your Phase-Walk ends.

steps.text: Play The Spirit, end a Phase-Walk, then down a Survivor soon after; do this 30 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Spirit using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Spirit in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Spirit's three unique perks as your only perks: Rancor, Hex: Haunted Ground, and Spirit Fury.
Play a public match as The Spirit and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, break a total of 50 individual Hooks.
achievements.summary: Sabotage 50 different Hooks.

steps.text: Sabotage Hooks with a Toolbox, for example a Commodious Toolbox with Built to Last, until you have broken 50 in total.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Chalet and live to tell the tale.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Chalet within Mount Ormond Resort, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Mount Ormond Resort}.
Repair the Generator located in the Chalet until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Jeff using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Jeff Johansen while having only Jeff Johansen's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Jeff Johansen, equip only these three: Breakdown; Aftercare; Distortion. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, hit 25 different individual Survivors while carrying another Survivor.
achievements.summary: Strike Survivors 25 times while you have another Survivor over your shoulder.

steps.text: Pick up a downed Survivor, then hit another Survivor while you still carry the first one.

achievements.description: In public matches, as the Legion, down 25 different Survivors that have Deep Wound applied.
achievements.summary: As The Legion, down 25 distinct Survivors while each one is afflicted with Deep Wound.

steps.text: Play The Legion and down Survivors who are afflicted with @mechanic{Deep Wound}, until 25 distinct Survivors have been downed this way.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Legion using only their 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Legion in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Legion's three unique perks as your only perks: Iron Maiden, Mad Grit, and Discordance.
Play a public match as The Legion and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, heal other Survivors for a total of 50 health states while you are also injured.
achievements.summary: While injured yourself, heal other Survivors for 50 Health States worth in public matches.

steps.text: Stay injured and heal other Survivors until you reach 50 Health States.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Temple basement and live to tell the tale.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Temple Catacombs within The Temple of Purgation, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{The Temple of Purgation}.
Repair the Generator located in the Temple Catacombs until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Jane using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Jane Romero while having only Jane Romero's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Jane Romero, equip only these three: Solidarity; Poised; Head On. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, sacrifice all survivors before the last generator is repaired, 15 times.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice every Survivor in a match before its final Generator gets repaired, on 25 separate matches.

steps.text: Sacrifice all four Survivors before the final Generator gets repaired; do this in 25 matches.

achievements.description: In public matches, with The Plague, down 50 Survivors affected by the maximum infection.
achievements.summary: Put 50 Survivors in the dying state while they have full Sickness and you play The Plague.

steps.text: Play The Plague and spread Sickness until a Survivor reaches maximum, then down that Survivor.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Plague using only their 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Plague in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Plague's three unique perks as your only perks: Dark Devotion, Infectious Fright, and Corrupt Intervention.
Play a public match as The Plague and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, while The Killer is carrying you, wiggle out of The Killer's grasp 10 times.
achievements.summary: Break out of the Killer's hold on you 10 times by wiggling.

guide.context: Being saved by a pallet stun does not count; you must wiggle out yourself.

steps.text: While carried by the Killer, wiggle free. Repeat until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, crawl your way out through the hatch.
achievements.summary: Crawl into the Hatch while in the Dying State to escape from a public match.

steps.text: Be the last Survivor, get downed, and crawl into the open Hatch.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Ash using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Ash Williams while having only Ash Williams's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Ash Williams, equip only these three: Flip-Flop; Buckle Up; Mettle of Man. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, interrupt and grab 25 Survivors while they are repairing generators.
achievements.summary: Pick up 25 Survivors who are working on a Generator.

steps.text: Find a Survivor repairing a Generator and grab them to interrupt.

achievements.description: In public matches, with Ghost Face, down 50 Marked Survivors.
achievements.summary: As The Ghost Face, bring Marked Survivors to the Dying State 50 times.

steps.text: Play as The Ghost Face, stalk Survivors until they are Marked, then down them until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Ghost Face using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Ghost Face in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Ghost Face's three unique perks as your only perks: Furtive Chase, Thrilling Tremors, and I'm All Ears.
Play a public match as The Ghost Face and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, close the hatch 30 times.
achievements.summary: Shut the Hatch 30 times in public matches.

steps.text: Shut the Hatch as the Killer; do this 30 times.

achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors next to raised pallets in public matches.
achievements.summary: Put Survivors down 30 times when they stand 8 metres or less from a Pallet that is still upright.

steps.text: Down Survivors that are within 8 metres of a Pallet that is still standing upright.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory 5 times in a public match with only 3 universal perks equipped.
achievements.summary: As a Killer, win with a Merciless Victory five times while only three General Perks are equipped.

guide.context: A Merciless Victory means all four Survivors are killed in the trial.

steps.text: Equip only three General Killer Perks and no other Perks.
Win with a Merciless Victory, then repeat until you have done it five times.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Treatment Theatre’s operation theatre and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Operating Theatre within Treatment Theatre, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Treatment Theatre}.
Repair the Generator located in the Operating Theatre until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: Escape 8 times while repairing the equivalent of 1 generator with only 2 universal perks equipped.
achievements.summary: Escape 8 times, each time after repairing the equivalent of 1 Generator and with just 2 General Survivor Perks equipped.

guide.context: General Survivor Perks are the ones that do not belong to a specific Survivor.

steps.text: Equip only 2 General Survivor Perks and no other Perks.
Repair the equivalent of one Generator, then escape. Repeat until you have done it 8 times.

achievements.description: Escape 8 times while repairing the equivalent of 1 generator with only 3 universal perks equipped.
achievements.summary: Escape 8 times with just 3 Generic Perks equipped, having completed repair work worth 1 Generator each time.

steps.text: Equip only 3 Generic Perks, such as Kindred, We'll Make It or Will to Live. Do repair work worth one Generator, and escape. Do this 8 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, hook a Survivor while 3 other Survivors are injured, 10 times.
achievements.summary: Put a Survivor on a hook on 10 occasions when all four Survivors in the Trial are injured.

steps.text: Hook a Survivor at a moment when all four Survivors are injured; do this 10 times.

achievements.description: In public matches with The Oni, down 75 Survivors during Blood Fury.
achievements.summary: As The Oni, bring 75 Survivors to the ground while Blood Fury is active.

steps.text: Play The Oni and down Survivors while Blood Fury is active; do this 75 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, achieve a merciless victory with The Oni using only his 3 unique perks.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Oni in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Oni's three unique perks as your only perks: Nemesis, Blood Echo, and Zanshin Tactics.
Play a public match as The Oni and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the upper level of the Shrine and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Shrine within Sanctum of Wrath, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Sanctum of Wrath}.
Repair the Generator located in the Shrine until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In public matches, take a protection hit while the Killer is carrying a Survivor, 30 times.
achievements.summary: Absorb a Protection Hit meant for a Survivor the Killer is carrying, 30 times.

steps.text: Take a hit from the Killer while they are carrying a teammate. Repeat until you have done it 30 times.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape with Yui Kimura using only her 3 unique perks.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Yui Kimura while having only Yui Kimura's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Yui Kimura, equip only these three: Lucky Break; Any Means Necessary; Breakout. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Down speared Survivors 30 times with The Deathslinger in public matches.
achievements.summary: As The Deathslinger, down 30 Survivors while The Redeemer has them speared.

steps.text: Play The Deathslinger, spear a Survivor with The Redeemer, then down that Survivor; do this 30 times.

achievements.description: Interrupt a Survivor cleansing a Totem 10 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Pick up 10 Survivors while they are cleansing a Totem.

steps.text: Find a Survivor cleansing a Totem and pick them up to interrupt the cleanse.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Deathslinger using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Deathslinger in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Deathslinger's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Retribution, Dead Man's Switch, and Gearhead.
Play a public match as The Deathslinger and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in the Saloon and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Saloon within Dead Dawg Saloon, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Dead Dawg Saloon}.
Repair the Generator located in the Saloon until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: Heal a Survivor from the dying state to the injured state 30 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Heal other Survivors from the Dying State to injured 30 times in public matches.

steps.text: Pick up downed Survivors so they become injured. Do this 30 times.

achievements.description: Escape with Zarina Kassir using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Zarina Kassir while having only Zarina Kassir's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Zarina Kassir, equip only these three: Off the Record; Red Herring; For the People. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Ensnare 30 Survivors in Cages of Atonement with The Executioner in public matches.
achievements.summary: As The Executioner, place 30 Survivors into a Cage of Atonement.

steps.text: Play The Executioner and put Survivors into a Cage of Atonement; do this 30 times.

achievements.description: Down a Survivor suffering from the Oblivious status effect 15 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Bring a Survivor who is Oblivious to the ground on 15 separate occasions.

steps.text: Down a Survivor who is under the @mechanic{Oblivious} status effect; do this 15 times.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Executioner using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Executioner in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Executioner's three unique perks as your only perks: Deathbound, Trail of Torment, and Forced Penance.
Play a public match as The Executioner and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, repair the generator in Midwich School's music room or chem lab and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Music Room or the Chemistry Laboratory within Midwich Elementary School, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Midwich Elementary School}.
Repair the Generator located in the Music Room or the Chemistry Laboratory until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: Heal other Survivors marked as the Obsession for a total of 10 health states in public matches.
achievements.summary: Restore 10 Health States to the Obsession.

steps.text: Heal the Obsession until the healing adds up to 10 Health States.

achievements.description: Escape with Cheryl Mason using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Cheryl Mason while having only Cheryl Mason's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Cheryl Mason, equip only these three: Soul Guard; Blood Pact; Repressed Alliance. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Hit 30 survivors with a Lethal Rush in public matches.
achievements.summary: Land 30 hits on Survivors using The Blight's Lethal Rush.

steps.text: Play The Blight and hit Survivors with Lethal Rush.

achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors suffering from the Exposed status effect in public matches.
achievements.summary: Put Survivors down 30 times while they are Exposed.

steps.text: Equip the Perk Ravenous and hook each Survivor for the first time until it holds 4 Tokens, which makes all Survivors Exposed. Then down Survivors while they are Exposed.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Blight using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Blight in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Blight's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Undying, Hex: Blood Favour, and Dragon's Grip.
Play a public match as The Blight and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: Deplete 30 items in public matches.
achievements.summary: Run Items down to empty 30 times.

steps.text: Use Items until their charges run out, 30 times in total.

achievements.description: Heal other Survivors for 10 health states while at least 3 Survivors are injured, dying or hooked.
achievements.summary: Heal teammates for a total of 10 health states while every Survivor in the Trial, you included, is injured, dying, or hooked.

guide.context: Healing only counts toward the total during moments when every Survivor in the Trial, including you, is injured, dying, or hooked.

steps.text: Keep healing teammates while the whole team is injured, dying, or hooked, until your total reaches 10 health states.

achievements.description: Escape with Felix Richter using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Felix Richter while having only Felix Richter's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Felix Richter, equip only these three: Visionary; Desperate Measures; Built to Last. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: With The Twins, down 10 Survivors while Victor is clinging to them in a public match.
achievements.summary: While you play The Twins, down 10 Survivors who have Victor clinging to them.

steps.text: Play The Twins, send Victor to latch onto a Survivor, then down that Survivor.

achievements.description: Hook 15 Survivors during the End Game Collapse in public matches.
achievements.summary: Hook 15 Survivors while the Endgame Collapse is under way.

steps.text: Hook Survivors while the Endgame Collapse is under way; do this 15 times.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Twins using only their 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Twins in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Twins's three unique perks as your only perks: Coup de Grâce, Oppression, and Hoarder.
Play a public match as The Twins and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: Stun the Killer with a pallet while they are carrying a Survivor 5 times.
achievements.summary: Drop a Pallet on the Killer to stun them while a Survivor is on their shoulder, 5 times.

steps.text: Stun the Killer by dropping a Pallet on them as they carry someone, which frees that Survivor. Do this 5 times.

achievements.description: Equip 0 perks, repair generators for a total of 1 full repair and escape 8 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Escape 8 times in public matches after repairing the equivalent of 1 Generator with no Perks equipped.

steps.text: Equip no Perks, do the equivalent of one full Generator repair, and escape. Do this 8 times.

achievements.description: Escape with Élodie using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Élodie Rakoto while having only Élodie Rakoto's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Élodie Rakoto, equip only these three: Appraisal; Deception; Power Struggle. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Deal maximum Laceration on Survivors 50 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Bring Survivors to full Laceration 50 times.

guide.context: Six Blade hits on one Survivor reach maximum Laceration.

steps.text: Play The Trickster and throw Blades at a Survivor until they take maximum Laceration.

achievements.description: Down 30 Survivors while carrying another Survivor in public matches.
achievements.summary: With one Survivor on your shoulder, put a different Survivor down 30 times.
