achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Movie Theatre within Greenville Square, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Greenville Square}.
Repair the Generator located in the Movie Theatre until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: In public matches, heal a total of 25 Health States while in the Basement.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, heal yourself a total of 25 times while inside the Basement.

steps.text: Heal yourself while inside the Basement until you reach 25 in total.

achievements.description: Escape with Sable using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Sable Ward while having only Sable Ward's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Sable Ward, equip only these three: Invocation: Weaving Spiders; Strength in Shadows; Wicked. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Discover a hidden Guardian at the Yamaoka Estate.
achievements.summary: Discover the hidden Tanuki statue at the Yamaoka Estate.

guide.context: Only one player can find it in each match, so search early.

steps.text: Load into either Yamaoka Estate map.
Search the outer walls and map edges, away from vaults, pallets and generators, until you find the Tanuki statue.
Crouch next to the statue for a moment until it breaks.

achievements.description: As The Lich, injure a Survivor with a basic attack within 15 seconds of casting a spell 25 times.
achievements.summary: As The Lich, land 25 hits on Survivors, each one coming no later than 15 seconds after you cast a Spell.

steps.text: Play The Lich, cast a Spell, then land a hit on a Survivor before 15 seconds pass; repeat until you have 25 such hits.

achievements.description: As The Lich, collect the Hand or Eye of Vecna and kill or sacrifice all Survivors in the same match.
achievements.summary: While you play The Lich, recover either Vecna relic (the Eye or the Hand) off a Survivor who is downed on Death Hook, then kill or sacrifice every Survivor before that match ends.

steps.text: Wait for a Survivor to find a Vecna relic (the Eye or the Hand) in a chest. Each chest a Survivor opens has a 5% chance to hold one.
When that Survivor is on Death Hook, down them again, stand next to them and hold the retrieve prompt to take the relic.
Kill or sacrifice all Survivors before the match ends.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Lich using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Lich in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Lich's three unique perks as your only perks: Dark Arrogance, Languid Touch, and Weave Attunement.
Play a public match as The Lich and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator inside the torture room in the Forgotten Ruins and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Torture Room within Forgotten Ruins, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Forgotten Ruins}.
Repair the Generator located in the Torture Room until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: Find and use the Hand or Eye of Vecna and escape a Trial.
achievements.summary: Obtain the Hand or the Eye of Vecna, use it, then escape the trial.

guide.context: These items only turn up in matches where The Lich is the Killer. Using one makes you Broken for 30 seconds.

steps.text: Open Treasure Chests until one gives you the Eye of Vecna or Hand of Vecna.
Use the item, then escape the trial.

achievements.description: Escape with Aestri or Baermar using only their 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Aestri Yazar or Baermar Uraz while having only their three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Aestri Yazar or Baermar Uraz, equip only these three: Mirrored Illusion; Bardic Inspiration; Still Sight. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, perform a fast vault within 3 seconds of getting hit 15 times.
achievements.summary: Do a Rushed Vault no more than 3 seconds after the Killer hits you, 15 times.

steps.text: After the Killer hits you, vault a window or pallet with a Rushed Vault within 3 seconds. Repeat until you reach 15.

achievements.description: In public matches, swap held Survivor items for new ones from chests 10 times (max once per chest).
achievements.summary: Swap your held Item for a new Item from Chests 10 times in public matches, counting each Chest once.

steps.text: Open a Chest while holding an Item and swap it for the new Item. Each Chest counts once.

achievements.description: Escape with Lara using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Lara Croft while having only Lara Croft's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Lara Croft, equip only these three: Finesse; Hardened; Specialist. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, interrupt 10 Survivors while they are performing a vault.
achievements.summary: Catch 10 Survivors by grabbing them partway through a vault.

steps.text: Grab a Survivor while they are vaulting.

achievements.description: Playing as The Dark Lord, hit 20 Survivors using Hellfire in public matches.
achievements.summary: Hit or damage Survivors with the Hellfire Spell 20 times while you play The Dark Lord.

steps.text: Play The Dark Lord and hit Survivors with Hellfire.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Dark Lord using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Dark Lord in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Dark Lord's three unique perks as your only perks: Dominance, Human Greed, and Hex: Wretched Fate.
Play a public match as The Dark Lord and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, reveal the Killer's aura for a total of 60 seconds in a single trial.
achievements.summary: In a single trial, reveal the Killer's Aura for a total of 60 seconds.

steps.text: Reveal the Killer's Aura with Kindred, or Eyes of Belmont with Alert, until it adds up to 60 seconds in one trial.

achievements.description: In public matches, pallet stun the Killer 10 times while holding a rare, common, or uncommon item.
achievements.summary: Hit the Killer with a Pallet stun 10 times while carrying a Common, Uncommon or Rare Item.

steps.text: Carry a Common, Uncommon or Rare Item and stun the Killer with a Pallet, ten times in total.

achievements.description: Escape with Trevor using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Trevor Belmont while having only Trevor Belmont's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Trevor Belmont, equip only these three: Exultation; Moment of Glory; Eyes of Belmont. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, as a Killer, fall a combined distance of 1000 meters.
achievements.summary: As the Killer in public matches, accumulate 1000 metres of falling.

steps.text: Drop from high places as the Killer until your combined fall distance reaches 1000 metres.

achievements.description: Playing as The Houndmaster, injure 25 Survivors detained by the Dog in public matches.
achievements.summary: As The Houndmaster, hurt Survivors who are being held by The Dog on 25 separate occasions.

steps.text: Play The Houndmaster and hit Survivors while The Dog is holding them in place; do this 25 times.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Houndmaster using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Houndmaster in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Houndmaster's three unique perks as your only perks: No Quarter, Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass, and All-Shaking Thunder.
Play a public match as The Houndmaster and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, escape a match while being Broken a total of 5 times.
achievements.summary: Leave a trial while Broken 5 times.

steps.text: Become Broken with For the People (used at the Exit Gate), Moment of Glory or Invocation: Weaving Spiders, then leave the trial through an Exit Gate or the Hatch. Repeat until you have done it 5 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, safely unhook Survivors while being Broken a total of 10 times.
achievements.summary: While Broken, safely unhook a teammate 10 times.

steps.text: Become Broken with No Mither, Invocation: Weaving Spiders or Moment of Glory, then safely unhook a teammate. Repeat until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.description: Escape with Taurie Cain using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Taurie Cain while having only Taurie Cain's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Taurie Cain, equip only these three: Invocation: Treacherous Crows; Clean Break; Shoulder the Burden. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Playing as The Ghoul in public matches, perform 30 perfectly timed grab-attacks.
achievements.summary: As The Ghoul, perform perfectly timed Grab-Attacks a total of 30 times.

guide.context: A grab only works from the second or third Kagune Leap, on a Survivor who is not already in Deep Wound, and not if the leap carried you over a pallet or window.

steps.text: As The Ghoul, grab a Survivor with the second or third Kagune Leap.
When the grab prompt turns bloody, press the Attack button right away (M1 on PC).

achievements.description: In public matches, damage a Survivor who just blinded you within 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: As the Killer in a public match, hit a Survivor no more than 30 seconds after that Survivor blinded you.

steps.text: Hit the Survivor who blinded you before 30 seconds have passed since the blinding.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Ghoul using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Ghoul in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Ghoul's three unique perks as your only perks: None Are Free, Forever Entwined, and Hex: Nothing but Misery.
Play a public match as The Ghoul and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, take 10 protection hits during the Endgame Collapse.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, take 10 Protection Hits during the Endgame Collapse.

guide.context: The Endgame Collapse only starts once an Exit Gate is open or the Hatch is closed. Healthy teammates are not eligible; the one nearby must be injured.

steps.text: During the Endgame Collapse, take a hit from the Killer while it is carrying a teammate or while you are within about 8 metres of an injured teammate. Repeat until you reach 10.

achievements.description: In public matches, complete 20 healing actions on Survivors once all generators have been completed.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, complete healing actions on Survivors a total of 20 times after all Generators are repaired.

guide.context: Healing yourself does not count.

steps.text: Once every Generator is repaired, heal other Survivors until you have completed 20 healing actions.

achievements.description: Escape with Orela Rose using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Orela Rose while having only Orela Rose's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Orela Rose, equip only these three: Do No Harm; Duty of Care; Rapid Response. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Playing as The Animatronic, interrupt a Survivor in the Security Office 15 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Stop 15 Survivors from passing through the Security Office while you play The Animatronic.

steps.text: Play The Animatronic and interrupt a Survivor while they pass through the Security Office.

achievements.description: In public matches, hit 5 Survivors that are Oblivious.
achievements.summary: Strike Oblivious Survivors 5 times.

steps.text: Play The Nightmare so Survivors fall Asleep, which makes them Oblivious, then hit a Survivor who is Oblivious.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Animatronic using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Animatronic in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Animatronic's three unique perks as your only perks: Haywire, Phantom Fear, and Help Wanted.
Play a public match as The Animatronic and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a public match, complete the generator at the Fallen Refuge and escape.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing the Generator located in the Prison Tower within Fallen Refuge, then get out of that same Trial alive as a Survivor in a public match.

steps.text: Play a public match as a Survivor on @loc{Fallen Refuge}.
Repair the Generator located in the Prison Tower until it is finished.
Escape the Trial.

achievements.description: Escape with Rick Grimes using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Rick Grimes while having only Rick Grimes's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Rick Grimes, equip only these three: Apocalyptic Ingenuity; Come and Get Me!; Teamwork: Toughen Up. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Escape with Michonne Grimes using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Michonne Grimes while having only Michonne Grimes's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Michonne Grimes, equip only these three: Conviction; Last Stand; Teamwork: Throw Down. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: As The Krasue, use Intestinal Whip to put Survivors in the dying state 20 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: As The Krasue, bring Survivors to the Dying State with the Intestinal Whip attack 20 times.

steps.text: Play as The Krasue and down Survivors with the Intestinal Whip until the total reaches 20.

achievements.description: Injure Survivors after you vaulted during a chase 20 times in public matches.
achievements.summary: Injure a Survivor soon after your own vault in a chase, on 20 separate occasions.

steps.text: Vault during a chase, then injure that Survivor soon after; do this 20 times.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Krasue using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Krasue in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Krasue's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Overture of Doom, Wandering Eye, and Ravenous.
Play a public match as The Krasue and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In public matches, finish repairing 10 generators while injured.
achievements.summary: Finish repairing 10 Generators while injured in public matches.

steps.text: Stay injured and complete a Generator. Do this 10 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, succeed in 100 healing or repair skill checks.
achievements.summary: Succeed at 100 Skill Checks while repairing or healing in public matches.

steps.text: Repair Generators or heal Survivors in public matches, passing Skill Checks until you reach 100 successes.

achievements.description: Escape with Vee Boonyasak using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Vee Boonyasak while having only Vee Boonyasak's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Vee Boonyasak, equip only these three: Road Life; One-Two-Three-Four!; Ghost Notes. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, damage a Survivor using the Vine or Undergate Attacks 50 times.
achievements.summary: Playing as The First, damage Survivors using the Vine Attack or Undergate Attack 50 times.

guide.context: Only attacks that take away a health state count, so progress begins once Worldbreaker is active.

steps.text: Play as The First and damage Survivors with the Vine Attack or Undergate Attack until you reach 50.

achievements.description: In public matches, damage a Survivor while they are healing another or repairing 5 times.
achievements.summary: Damage a Survivor 5 times while they are healing another Survivor or repairing.

steps.text: Strike a Survivor in the middle of healing a teammate or repairing.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The First using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The First in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The First's three unique perks as your only perks: Hex: Hive Mind, Secret Project, and Turn Back the Clock.
Play a public match as The First and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: Reveal or see the Killer's aura 11 times in a single trial in a public match.
achievements.summary: Have the Killer's Aura revealed or visible to you 11 times in one public match.

steps.text: Equip Perks that show the Killer's Aura, such as We See You, Extrasensory Perception, Alert or Kindred. Keep seeing the Killer's Aura until it has shown 11 times in one match.

achievements.description: Escape with Dustin Henderson using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Dustin Henderson while having only Dustin Henderson's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Dustin Henderson, equip only these three: Bada Bada Boom; Change of Plan; Teamwork: Full Circuit. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Escape with Eleven using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Eleven while having only Eleven's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Eleven, equip only these three: Extrasensory Perception; We See You; Teamwork: Soft-Spoken. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In a single trial in public matches, be chased by the Killer for a total of 90 seconds.
achievements.summary: Spend 90 seconds in total being pursued by the Killer within one trial.

steps.text: Stay in a chase with the Killer until the chase time adds up to 90 seconds in one trial.

achievements.description: In a single trial in public matches, heal the Obsession 3 times.
achievements.summary: In a single trial, heal the Obsession 3 times.

guide.context: Healing yourself counts when you are the Obsession.

steps.text: Heal the Obsession three times before the trial ends.

achievements.description: Escape with Kwon Tae-young using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Kwon Tae-young while having only Kwon Tae-young's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Kwon Tae-young, equip only these three: Flow State; A Place For Us; Five Moves Ahead. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, immobilize Survivors to a wall 13 times as The Slasher.
achievements.summary: As The Slasher, pin Survivors to a wall 13 times.

steps.text: Play The Slasher and throw a Spike at an injured Survivor so the hit puts them in the Dying State, then make the push slam them into a wall.

achievements.description: In public matches, down 13 Survivors within 30 seconds of breaking a Pallet or Wall.
achievements.summary: In public matches, put 13 Survivors down inside 30 seconds after you smash a Pallet or Breakable Wall.

steps.text: Smash a Pallet or Breakable Wall and put a Survivor down inside 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Slasher using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Slasher in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Slasher's three unique perks as your only perks: Rampage, Silent Shadow, and Hex: Scared to Death.
Play a public match as The Slasher and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: In a single match, block the same Pallet 3 times.
achievements.summary: Block the same Pallet 3 times in a single match.

steps.text: As a Survivor, equip the Perk Wide Open Throttle, drop one Pallet, vault it, and come back later to block it again. Do this until the same Pallet has been blocked 3 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, give a total of 16 permanent healing charges to Survivors.
achievements.summary: Use the Perk Lend a Hand in public matches to grant your teammates 16 permanent healing charges in total.

steps.text: Equip the Perk Lend a Hand, cleanse a Hex totem, then use the Perk's ability while healing another Survivor. The Tier III version gives 4 charges each time, so do this 4 times.

achievements.description: Escape with Shane Wiigwaas using only his 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Shane Wiigwaas while having only Shane Wiigwaas's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Shane Wiigwaas, equip only these three: Wide Open Throttle; Lend a Hand; Cross-Examination. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: In public matches, As The Judgment, hit 15 Survivors with Divine Light from at least 16 meters away.
achievements.summary: As The Judgment, strike 15 Survivors with Divine Light when they are at least 16 metres from you.

steps.text: Play as The Judgment and cast Divine Light so it hits Survivors from 16 metres or farther, 15 times.

achievements.description: In public matches, see the Obsession's Aura for a total of 300 seconds.
achievements.summary: As a Killer, watch the Obsession's Aura for 300 seconds in total.

steps.text: As a Killer, see the Obsession's Aura, for example with Lethal Pursuer, until the time adds up to 300 seconds.

achievements.description: Achieve a merciless victory with The Judgment using only Its 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.estTime: About 3 trials once the Killer and perks are owned
achievements.summary: As The Judgment in a public match, achieve a Merciless Victory while using only that Killer's three unique perks.

steps.text: Equip The Judgment's three unique perks as your only perks: Lay Waste, Celestial Witness, and Hex: Under Your Thumb.
Play a public match as The Judgment and kill all four Survivors to finish with a Merciless Victory.

achievements.description: As The Judgment, Exile a Survivor who gained Heresy by taunting you.
achievements.summary: As The Judgment, Exile a Survivor who gained Heresy by taunting you.

guide.context: A Survivor with Heresy is called a Heretic. The Exile only accepts a Heretic you have already downed.

steps.text: Play The Judgment and wait for a Survivor to taunt you until they gain Heresy.
Down that Heretic so they are in the Dying State.
Press the Secondary Power button to send them to the Exile.

achievements.description: In a public match, escape The Judgment's Exile without being hit by Seeds of Punishment.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, get out of The Judgment's Exile without being struck by a Seed of Punishment.

guide.context: Your own Survivor must be sent to the Exile by the Killer, so this needs a match against The Judgment.

steps.text: Get sent to the Exile by The Judgment, then have a teammate rescue you from it like from a Hook, without being struck by a Seed of Punishment.

achievements.description: In public matches, gain a health state within 10 seconds of a Generator being completed 5 times.
achievements.summary: Within 10 seconds of a Generator finishing, move up a Health State 5 times in public matches.

steps.text: Heal yourself or be healed right as a Generator finishes. Do this 5 times in public matches.

achievements.description: Escape with Aurora using only her 3 unique perks in a public match.
achievements.summary: Escape a Trial in a public match as Aurora Stardotter while having only Aurora Stardotter's three unique perks equipped.

guide.context: Escaping through the Hatch counts the same as escaping through an Exit Gate.

steps.text: Play as Aurora Stardotter, equip only these three: Fruits of Your Labor; Salvation's Cry; Boon: Steadfast. Then escape the Trial in a public match.

achievements.description: Gain Heresy by taunting The Judgment.
achievements.summary: As a Survivor, gain Heresy by taunting The Judgment.

guide.context: Another player has to be playing The Judgment in your match.

steps.text: In a match against The Judgment, get within 10 metres of the Killer.
Crouch or gesture 3 times to taunt them until you gain Heresy.
steps.note: Standing inside an Exit Threshold for 45 seconds also counts as taunting.
